G9721.d: 1. Radic. sense, to pour : 2. properly of liquids, to pour out, pour , [8th/7th c.BC], etc.; Zeus χέει ὕδωρ, i. e. he makes it rain, [8th/7th c.BC]; χέει χιόνα βορέας [Refs 5th c.BC]; absolute, χέει it snows , [8th/7th c.BC]:—;Mid. to pour for oneself , especially of drink-offerings, χοὰς χεόμην νεκύεσσι [8th/7th c.BC], etc.:—;Pass., χέονται κρῆναι they gush forth , [Refs 5th c.BC]; χυθέντος ποτοῦ ἐς γῆν [Refs 5th c.BC] 3. χ. δάκρυα to shed  tears, [8th/7th c.BC, Refs 5th c.BC]:—;Pass., of tears, to pour  or gush forth , [8th/7th c.BC]; so of blood, to be shed , [6th/5th c.BC] 4. in Pass. to become liquid, melt, thaw , [5th/4th c.BC] 5. of solids, to shed, scatter , φύλλα [8th/7th c.BC]; πτερά [8th/7th c.BC]; χ. κόνιν κὰκ κεφαλῆς [8th/7th c.BC]; χ. καλάμην χθονί, of a mower or reaper (see. καλάμη), [8th/7th c.BC] 6. like χώννυμι, to throw out  earth, so as to form a mound, σῆμα, τύμβον χ. [8th/7th c.BC] 7. χ. δοῦρα to pour  or shower  spears, [8th/7th c.BC]; Mid., βέλεα χέοντο they showered their  arrows, [8th/7th c.BC] 8. to let fall  or drop , ἡνία [8th/7th c.BC]; so, χέειν κρόκου βαφὰς (see. βαφή II) [6th/5th c.BC]; but, καρπὸν χ., of trees, to produce  fruit abundantly , [8th/7th c.BC] 9. in Pass. to be thrown  or heaped up together , [8th/7th c.BC, Refs 5th c.BC] 10. in Pass. also of living beings, to pour  or stream in a dense mass  or throng , [8th/7th c.BC] 11. metaphorically of sounds, to pour forth , φωνήν, αὐδήν [8th/7th c.BC]; φθόγγον [6th/5th c.BC] 12. of things that obscure the sight, κατ᾽ ὀφθαλμῶν χέεν ἀχλύν shed  a dark cloud over the eyes, [8th/7th c.BC]; πολλὴν ἠέρα χεῦε shed  a mist abroad, [8th/7th c.BC]:—;Pass., ἀμφὶ δέ οἱ θάνατος χύτο was shed  around him, [8th/7th c.BC]; νόσος κέχυται [Refs 5th c.BC]; φρὶξ ἐπὶ πόντον ἐχεύατο (Mid. in passive sense), [8th/7th c.BC] 13. of persons, ἀμφ᾽ αὐτῶι χυμένη throwing herself  around him, [8th/7th c.BC]: so in Mid., ἀμφὶ υἱὸν ἐχεύατο πήχεε [8th/7th c.BC] 14. perfect passive κέχυμαι, to be wholly engaged in , Δᾶλος, ἐν ἇι κέχυμαι [Refs 5th c.BC] (ML)
